muted.$description: Secondary text: hints, captions, helper copy.

link.$description: Link text; 4.5:1 on the canvas and subtle surfaces.

subtle.$description: Quiet panel or band behind content, one step off the canvas.

raised.$description: Cards and floating layers; pair with the elevation tokens.

inverse.$description: Dark surface; text on it uses text.inverse.

brand.$description: Brand-filled surface; text on it uses text.on-brand.

gradient-start.$description: Start (top left) of the .ds-tone-gradient surface. Roles inside the gradient tone are checked against both stops.

gradient-end.$description: End (bottom right) of the .ds-tone-gradient surface. Keep it at least as dark as gradient-start: the tone reuses the on-brand roles, which are light on dark.

default.$description: Decorative separators and neutral outlines. Not a control boundary (3:1 not guaranteed).

strong.$description: Emphasised separators and outlines. Not a control boundary (3:1 not guaranteed).

control.$description: Boundary of an interactive control; meets 3:1 against the canvas.

border.$description: Input outline; meets 3:1 against the input fill and the canvas.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text; 4.5:1 on the input fill.

fg.$description: Error text and icons; 4.5:1 on the canvas and feedback.danger.bg.

border.$description: Error outline; meets 3:1 against the canvas and feedback.danger.bg.

scrim.$description: Translucent backdrop behind modal layers (has alpha, so no contrast pair).

fg.$description: Text and icons on the primary action fill.
Text and icons on the secondary action fill.

border.$description: Secondary action outline; meets 3:1 against its fills.

ring.$description: Keyboard focus ring colour; meets 3:1 against the canvas.

ring-offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

fg.$description: Disabled control text (exempt from contrast requirements).
